title: Large Magnet Top for SLX Tray
description:
SLX Large Magnet Top
The Large Magnet Top lid is specifically designed for use with the SLX Large Non-Stick Ceramic Coated Tray. The entire lid is made out of a sheet of magnet and has a beautiful piece of art called War Bird.
Included
1 x SLX Large Magnet Top
